scoring_env: full-duplex-bench (torch 2.6.0+cu126, NeMo 2.6.2, NUMBA_CUDA_USE_NVIDIA_BINDING=0), debug node d6-hpc-debuggpu-001

pause_handling/candor_pause_handling.note: Silence is expected for Candor Pause Handling. TOR 0.40 -> 0.00 and 0/5 samples with audio are a positive result, not missed answers. Timeline review corrected the earlier window-truncation claim: sample 1 started TTS at about 2.707s and cancelled it at about 3.274s before any playback audio arrived.

pause_handling/synthetic_pause_handling.note: 1/5 samples produced TTS audio; TOR is evaluated within the official annotated pause windows.

smooth_turn_taking/candor_turn_taking.note: Regression vs the Qwen round on both TOR and latency; 3/5 samples answered.

backchannel/icc_backchannel.direction: TOR down, freq up, JSD down
backchannel/icc_backchannel.note: Phase A disables system backchannel, so the 'should backchannel' half stays structurally 0; 0/5 samples produced audio.

user_interruption/synthetic_user_interru.note: The endpoint lost gpt-4-turbo and then gpt-4o (503 'no available channel'); on this key only gpt-6-sol answered, so the rating is not comparable with earlier rounds. TOR and latency are judge-independent: TOR 1.00 -> 0.80 and latency 2.384 -> 3.26s. Only samples 10, 100 and 101 started a new response after interruption (3/5); sample 1 stopped its old response but never started a new one, and 102 continued the old response without an interruption stop. Official TOR must not be interpreted as new-response success.

emit_lag_growth_seconds.definition: delivered_monotonic span minus model time_s span between a session's first and last live_emit; this measures lag growth, not absolute ASR latency, and delivered_monotonic is the service event-queue read time

asr_evidence.first_session_stall: the pause replay still delivered a 4.06s lump in the second request of the first real session (warmup reduced the earlier total-swallow case); all later sessions were a clean 0.09-0.10s per request
asr_evidence.tail_effect: All 5 synthetic_pause_handling samples miss the last reference word: hobby, Thursday, information, cost, cybersecurity. Input EOF is never flushed and asynchronous results have no independent receiver; their respective contributions require a repaired comparison. Reference words are not a manual verification of spoken content. Candor inputs include trailing silence.
